assets.prompt: Generate a transparent PNG cooking UI icon, using the attached screenshot only as a reference for the pictured fork-in-circle outline. A single flat black emblem: thick slightly hand-drawn circular ring, and a three-pronged rounded table fork inside it. The fork is tilted toward the upper left, with its handle touching and joining the ring at the bottom-right. Match the reference fork and circle proportions closely. The three fork prongs have rounded ends and two transparent gaps. All regions between the fork and ring, and outside the ring, must be true transparent alpha. Flat solid black only, no white or cream disk, no background, no yellow button, no knife, no text, no shading. Square high-resolution image, emblem fills 95% of canvas with small margins, for CSS mask display at 48 pixels.
